text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what should we do...?
...Yeah, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Good luck in today's Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: ...I'm glad it went well, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why are you asking that like a question?
choice_data_list: Because Air Shakur herself doesn't seem happy...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Those kinds of things have really been popping up a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It's true that interview requests suddenly surged after the Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps by repeatedly crashing into such clear, visible walls, Air Shakur gained more overall exposure, making it easier for fans to raise their voices in support.
choice_data_list: That means people are starting to recognize you.
That means you're starting to get the recognition you deserve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I feel it's almost too late, but regardless,
what she's searching for might just be right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Once this race is over,
everything will change... Is this just intuition?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To be recognized—
that's what you've wanted all this time, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...No, don't think about it right now.
She's not an opponent you can beat with stray thoughts.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Worry about what comes after winning
when the time comes.
